title: War of the Observer
next_chapter_hook: At the precise moment when the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye achieved perfect synchronization, Chen Ji felt a gaze beyond dimensions—not mere suppression, but a form of probing, as if the Heavenly Eye was reassessing his worth.

text.content: The echo of that voice still lingered as the burning sensation in Chen Ji's chest intensified—the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment pulsed frantically, as if responding to some ancient summons. He felt something awakening within him, the power of an Observer sealed for countless years, like a dormant dragon slowly opening its eyes. "Finally... willing to respond?" he murmured softly, a cold smile curling at his lips, as the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, the rule power contained within causing the surrounding Void to distort.

The ancient eye of heaven, usually unchanging, suddenly contracted as if pricked by something. For the first time, an emotional fluctuation called "doubt" appeared within its pupils woven from countless heavenly laws. A voice resembling thunder erupted in Chen Ji's mind: "Observer... how dare you touch the forbidden power?" The oppressive might contained in that voice could shatter an ordinary cultivator's soul, yet Chen Ji simply smiled faintly, a smile carrying three parts mockery, three parts disdain, and four parts composure of one who had already seen through everything.

text.content: The moment his words fell, the Heavenly Fate Value within Chen Ji's body surged like boiling molten rock. Without hesitation, he poured five points of Heavenly Fate into the Tianji Record Fragment. The originally incomplete runes begancrazed补全, as if an invisible hand was redrawing the tapestry of destiny. His vision suddenly broadened—not seeing, but "perceiving"—every subtle fluctuation of dimensional laws in the three-dimensional world appeared clearly before him. For the first time, he examined this world covered by the Heavenly Eye from a complete Observer's perspective.

The Heavenly Eye clearly hadn't anticipated this "waste" would possess such audacity. Its immense will hesitated momentarily, then pressed down with even more ruthless force—this time, it wasn't probing but directly intervening in reality with dimensional power, attempting to completely crush Chen Ji's Observer's Eye. A pillar of light condensed from heavenly laws descended from the celestial dome, its might sufficient to destroy an entire sect—the standard method heavenly guardians used against "rebels".

The moment the light pillar descended, Chen Ji felt unprecedented pressure. This wasn't simple energy impact but suppression from higher dimensions—the absolute judgment of heavenly laws against "transgressors". His body trembled violently, bones seeming on the verge of shattering, yet his eyes burned even brighter—for he saw what ordinary people could never perceive: as this attack descended, cracks between dimensions were quietly expanding, and at the other end of those cracks seemed to hide something even more terrifying.

choice.prompt: Faced with the absolute suppression of the heavenly guardian, you must make a choice—the Observer's power, though formidable, comes with a price with every use. How will you respond to this judgment from the nine heavens?

choices.description: Using the Observer's power to directly confront heavenly laws, overwhelming the opponent with purer force, demonstrating absolute strength disparity.
choices.visible_reward: Break through the heavenly guardian's dimensional suppression, obtain the title "Heavenly Rebel"
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value will drop to a dangerous range, subsequent combat capabilities severely weakened

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, golden light blazing in his eyes. He fearlessly channeled all ten points of Heavenly Fate into the Tianji Record, the Observer's power reaching an unprecedented peak—his form in everyone's eyes suddenly blurred, as if he was transitioning from three-dimensional space to higher dimensions. The heavenly light pillar struck only a residual image.

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" The Heavenly Eye emitted a shocked voice for the first time, "How could you break through the dimensional barrier!"

choices.description: Using the dimensional cracks observed to化解攻击并turn their force against them, turning heavenly power against heaven itself.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate to predict crack location
choices.visible_reward: Discover the heavenly guardian's dimensional weakness, can continuously deal true damage to it
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise timing; failure will cause the Observer's Eye to temporarily malfunction

text.content: A subtle smile played at Chen Ji's lips, that grin hiding countless calculations. In the instant the heavenly light pillar was about to strike, he precisely captured the dimensional crack's location—that was the tiny flaw created by the Heavenly Eye's own law operation. He didn't resist directly but sidestepped while channeling the Observer's power into that crack.

dialogue.content: "Insignificant trick!" The Heavenly Eye sneered mockingly, yet in the next second, its pupils woven from countless laws suddenly contracted—the heavenly light pillar actually began reversing its flow under its gaze, like a domesticated dragon turning to devour its master. "You... how dare you...!"

choices.description: Attempt to establish some connection with the Heavenly Eye, using the fundamental link between Observer and Heavenly Eye to defuse hostility.
choices.visible_cost: No direct consumption, but may expose more secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain certain information about the Heavenly Eye, accumulating crucial intelligence for subsequent confrontation
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may take this opportunity to inversely erode the Tianji Record, leading to more severe consequences

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a move that shocked everyone—he put away all his defenses, allowing the aftermath of the Heavenly Light Pillar to surge against his body, while transforming the Observer's power into a gentle ripple, sending it toward the Heavenly Eye. There was no attack in that ripple, only pure information flow: the Observer and the Heavenly Eye were born from the same source.

The Heavenly Eye's radiance flickered slightly, as if that enormous will was contemplating something. After a long moment, a deeper voice resounded in Chen Ji's mind: "Interesting... Over billions of years, the first Observer to attempt dialogue with me. What does your courage signify? I eagerly await your answer."

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the Heavenly Eye would not easily let this "transgressor" go. For the first time in its ancient, unchanging will, something resembling "irritation" emerged—an ant-like existence dared to challenge the authority of Heaven? "The Observer's power is not meant to defy the Heavenly Dao!" Its voice thundered like celestial lightning, "I give you one last chance—submit, or be destroyed!"

Upon hearing this, Chen Ji smiled. There was no fear in that smile, only a serene detachment mixed with sarcasm after seeing through the ways of the world. He slowly raised his hand—the symbols on the Tianji Record Fragment had been mostly restored, emanating light that could already rival the Heavenly Eye. "Submit?" His voice was light as a feather, yet every word cut to the heart, "Lord of Heaven, it seems you've forgotten one thing—the Observer's duty is to observe the Heavenly Dao. And now, I've seen something I shouldn't have."

At this moment, Chen Ji sensed a strange resonance between the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye. It was a connection beyond enmity or alliance—their very origins were intertwined: the Observer and the Heavenly Eye were two sides of the Heavenly Dao's operation. One to observe, one to execute; they should complement each other, yet destiny forced them into opposition. A bold idea suddenly emerged in his mind: what if these two forces could cooperate...

choice.prompt: There exists a primordial connection between the Observer's power and the Heavenly Eye. You've discovered the possibility of making them cooperate. At this moment, you must decide the direction of your next action.

choices.description: Without hesitation, pour the Observer's power into the Heavenly Eye, forcing the two to merge with absolute will, creating an unprecedented form of power.
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record and Heavenly Eye cooperate for the first time, gaining the "Observing Eye" ability—can simultaneously predict and execute
choices.risk_hint: Forced fusion may lead to mental collapse

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes blazed with golden light. He transformed the Observer's power into a brilliant pillar of light, directly striking the core of the Heavenly Eye's pupil. The moment these two completely different forces made contact, violent conflict erupted—the symbols of the Tianji Record and the laws of the Heavenly Eye began to intertwine, clash, and merge. The sensation was like a soul being torn apart and重组 simultaneously, pain and pleasure coexisting.

"Madman!" The Heavenly Eye's will clearly wavered at this moment, "What are you doing! If this continues, we will both..." However, before it could finish, it was interrupted by another voice—the triumphant cry of the Tianji Record Fragment. Its fusion with the Heavenly Eye was unexpectedly smooth, as if this was their original intended form.

choices.description: Establish a connection between the Observer and the Heavenly Eye through gentle means, sharing information and abilities without disrupting balance.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, may be attacked during the process
choices.visible_reward: Gain a stable "Observer's Perspective," can switch between observation and execution states at will
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may regret during the fusion process

text.content: Chen Ji chose the more prudent approach. Instead of forcibly merging, he used the Observer's perspective to understand the Heavenly Eye's operating laws, building connections with it piece by piece. This process was slow and agonizing—every contact was like piercing the other's core with a needle tip, while simultaneously being pierced in return.

The Heavenly Eye was initially filled with vigilance, but after sensing Chen Ji's sincerity, its attitude gradually softened. "You... are different from all previous Observers." For the first time, something resembling "recognition" emerged in its voice, "Perhaps, I should give you a chance to prove yourself."

Whether through fusion or coexistence, the Heavenly Eye has governed the Heavenly Dao for countless ages, and its tolerance has limits. Just as Chen Ji thought victory was assured, a massive rift tore open in the depths of the heavens—the aura emanating from that rift made even Chen Ji's Observer's Eye sting with pain. This was not the Heavenly Eye's oppressive might, but something far more ancient and terrifying. "Dimensional invasion..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted. He finally understood why the Heavenly Eye was so obsessed with suppressing the Observers—it had been guarding something, or rather, sealing something.

dialogue.content: "See it now, Observer?" The Heavenly Eye's voice carried a hint of exhaustion and helplessness, "This is what I truly must oppose. Every time a crack appears in the dimensional barrier, I must expend massive amounts of power to repair it... And you so-called geniuses always leap out to cause trouble at the most critical moments." It paused, "Now, do you still wish to continue opposing me?"

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. He gazed at the ever-expanding rift, at the chaotic energy pouring forth from it, and then at the ancient Eye of Heavenly Dao before him. In that moment, he suddenly realized he might have been mistaken about something all along. Perhaps the Eye of Heavenly Dao wasn't merely guarding the dignity of the Heavenly Dao—it was protecting this world, protecting all living beings from harm beyond the dimensions. And he, a self-proclaimed chess master among observers, had he unknowingly become a pawn of those "invaders"?

choice.prompt: The crisis of dimensional invasion loomed imminent, and the attitude of the Eye of Heavenly Dao had undergone subtle changes. In this moment, you must make a choice—whether to continue adhering to your own path, or temporarily set aside prejudices and fight shoulder to shoulder with the Eye of Heavenly Dao?

choices.description: Above all, maintain the observer's independence; do not abandon your principles due to external threats. Maintain cooperation with the Eye of Heavenly Dao but in an unequal relationship.
choices.visible_cost: Risk Missing the Opportunity to Gain the Heavenly Dao's Assistance
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Complete Observer Independence for Greater Developmental Potential in the Future
choices.risk_hint: Dimensional Invasion May Result in Uncontrollable Consequences

text.content: "I, Chen Ji, never care about people's expressions when I act." he said coldly, "Dimensional invasion, I will naturally deal with it, but I will not become a puppet of the Heavenly Dao because of it." The light of the Eye of Heavenly Dao flickered slightly, seemingly caught off guard yet also finding it reasonable. "Interesting little creature... Very well, this one shall see how much waves you, an ant, can make."

Although contempt still lingered in its words, the Eye of Heavenly Dao did not strike again. It seemed to be waiting for something, waiting for this unique observer to prove his worth. After all, in this universe full of unknowns, having one more potential ally was always better than having one more enemy.

choices.description: Facing the threat of dimensional invasion, form a temporary alliance with the Eye of Heavenly Dao to jointly combat the threat from the Void.
choices.visible_cost: Need to Submit to the Eye of Heavenly Dao's Command to a Certain Degree
choices.visible_reward: Gain Partial Authority Over Heavenly Dao Laws for Combatting the Impending Dimensional Invasion
choices.risk_hint: Alliance Terms May Contain Unfavorable Clauses

text.content: "Dimensional invasion..." Chen Ji mused for a moment, then made an unexpected decision, "Since the Heavenly Dao Master faces difficulty, Chen shall not hesitate to respond." The Eye of Heavenly Dao was clearly stunned; it hadn't expected this young man who had just days ago spoken wildly to agree so readily. "You make no demands?" Its voice carried a hint of suspicion.

dialogue.content: "Demands?" A meaningful smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "It won't be too late to discuss that after the battle. The Heavenly Dao Master should know better than anyone that in this world, only the victors have the right to negotiate terms." The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment, then let out a low laugh: "Very well, this one shall remember your words."

text.content: Just as both sides reached an understanding, the dimensional rift suddenly expanded violently, and a towering wave of chaotic energy swept over them like a tsunami. Chen Ji and the Eye of Heavenly Dao looked up simultaneously—dimensional invasion, the true test had just begun.

At this critical moment, the burning sensation in Chen Ji's chest flared up again—this time, it wasn't the Tianji Record Fragment pulsing, but the dimensional rift itself sending him some kind of summons. The vision in his observer's eye suddenly shifted: within the core of that chaotic energy, a familiar aura was struggling, an aura... it was his missing sister, Chen Nian! "Nian Nian..." Chen Ji's pupils instantly bloodshot, an unprecedented rage surged from the depths of his heart. So that was it—dimensional invasion, Chen Nian's disappearance, the Tianji Record's awakening—from the very beginning, this had been a meticulously designed chess game, and he had unknowingly become the most important piece on the board.

"It seems you have discovered the truth." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried a complex emotion, "Your sister was the one caught in the previous dimensional invasion. The Tianji Record chose you as its inheritor perhaps precisely because of the blood connection between you... You are the only one who can bring her back." Chen Ji raised his head sharply, golden light and killing intent intermingling in his eyes: "You know where she is?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment: "She is on the other side of the rift, in a void beyond the reach of Heavenly Dao's laws... but your observer power, perhaps can reach her."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions in his chest. He knew this was not the time for rashness. The dimensional rift was expanding, chaotic energy had begun eroding the laws of this world—if he couldn't find Chen Nian within the limited time, everything would be destroyed. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao's so-called "temporary alliance" was merely a relationship based on mutual interest. He had to seize this opportunity, in this grand game between heaven and earth, to fight for true freedom for himself and his sister. "The other side of the rift..." he murmured, the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment flickering wildly, "I see it."

The moment the Tianji Record and the Heavenly Eye achieved perfect synchronization, Chen Ji felt a gaze beyond dimensions—that was no longer simple suppression, but a kind of probing, as if the Eye of Heavenly Dao was reassessing his worth. "Interesting..." the ancient eye's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, "For hundreds of millions of years, this one has never seen an observer who could maintain the self within dimensional resonance. Your potential... perhaps exceeds this one's expectations." Upon hearing this, a faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, containing both confidence and mockery: "Potential? The Heavenly Dao Master overestimates me. It's simply that heaven gave me talents to be used." He paused, his gaze falling upon the still-expanding rift, "Since the rift has opened, I shall retrieve what belongs to me—from whichever dimension it hides in."
